answer.rationale: Negotiate an immediate renewal with the incumbent, using market benchmarks, volume pricing, and payment terms to pursue the mandated savings while preserving supply continuity. Switching primary vendors is too risky with 14 days remaining, 94% committed utilization, and no buffer; the known low-cost vendor has repeatedly missed delivery SLAs. Verify the incumbent’s demonstrated continuity and prior negotiation results. Savings may fall short of 18%, so the agreement should preserve a later second-source review rather than trade delivery resilience for headline unit cost.
